subject.title: fix(security): add default pidsLimit for sandbox containers

question: Should OpenClaw make a positive Docker sandbox `pidsLimit` the default for existing unset configs, and what opt-out/docs/tests are required before that ships?
rationale: The hardening target is real, but changing an effective sandbox default can break existing deployments and needs owner approval of the security-versus-compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Approve default with upgrade proof
options.body: Keep the default-on PID cap only after schema, type docs, user docs, tests, and real Docker proof show fresh and upgrade behavior plus explicit override semantics.

options.title: Keep default unset
options.body: Preserve current upgrade behavior and document operator-configured `pidsLimit` as the supported hardening path.

options.title: Make strict cap opt-in
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved opt-in strict profile or setting if maintainers want the mitigation without changing existing unset deployments.

recommendation.title: Approve default with upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Keep the default-on PID cap only after schema, type docs, user docs, tests, and real Docker proof show fresh and upgrade behavior plus explicit override semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS assigns the affected sandbox runtime and docs paths to this team, and the unresolved choice is a sandbox security-boundary default.
